    LHL: for x<0x < 0x<0, ∣x∣=−x|x| = -x∣x∣=−x.

    lim⁡x→0−x−x+2x2=lim⁡x→0−1−1+2x=−1\lim_{x \to 0^-}\dfrac{x}{-x + 2x^{2}} = \lim_{x \to 0^-}\dfrac{1}{-1 + 2x} = -1x→0−lim​−x+2x2x​=x→0−lim​−1+2x1​=−1lim⁡x→0−x−x+2x2=lim⁡x→0−1−1+2x=−1\displaystyle \lim_{x \to 0^-}\dfrac{x}{-x + 2x^{2}} = \lim_{x \to 0^-}\dfrac{1}{-1 + 2x} = -1x→0−lim​−x+2x2x​=x→0−lim​−1+2x1​=−1
  2. 2

    −1≠1-1 \ne 1−1=1, so R is true.
